words.prose: {{ar:تِلْكَ}} ({{tr:tilka}}) turns the ayah from isolated letters into a compact act of pointing. Its feminine form waits for {{ar:ءَايَٰتُ}} ({{tr:āyātu}}), not for the masculine Book-word, so the reader must move forward to the predicate to know what has been indicated. The far-deictic form gives the present recited material a lifted or distant status: these signs are heard here, but the pointing treats them as already established beyond the immediate moment. Because the clause is nominal and verbless, the word does not narrate an event; it classifies the pointed material as signs of the clarifying Book. The short cadence also resets the sound after the extended letter names.

words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتُ}} ({{tr:āyātu}}) is the first lexical predicate of the clause: the thing pointed to by {{ar:تِلْكَ}} ({{tr:tilka}}) is classified as signs. Its feminine plural form supplies the agreement target, while its nominative predicate role makes signhood the identification being asserted. The word is also construct-bound, so the many signs cannot float independently; they are signs of {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}). Its local range keeps verse-units and evidentiary signs together: the textual units are themselves proofs. The disputed return or shelter image is only background pressure, but it gives the signs a point-of-recourse feel. The word also sits inside a recurring opening formula (10:1; 13:1; 15:1), while 11:1 reverses the orientation by making the Book head the clause and the signs possessed by it. In 12:1, the signs head the phrase, later sign references return within the surah (12:7; 12:35; 12:105), and the long-vowel cadence begins here before the Book and clarity fields are completed by {{ar:ٱلْمُبِينِ}} ({{tr:al-mubīni}}).

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) is the middle term that holds the predicate together. It is genitive under {{ar:ءَايَٰتُ}} ({{tr:āyātu}}), so the signs are specified as signs of the known Book; its definiteness also reaches back through the construct and identifies the signs. At the same time, {{ar:ٱلْمُبِينِ}} ({{tr:al-mubīni}}) agrees with this word, not directly with the plural signs, so the Book is the immediate bearer of clarification. The root range keeps writing, inscription, prescription, decree, and joining pressure in view, but locally this is the definite revealed Book, not a free activation of every register. As a noun, it presents an established repository rather than a writing event in progress. The word also participates in repeated Book-clarity and Book-sign formulae, while contrasts with cosmic-record uses (11:6; 10:61; 6:59), fixed-term decree language (13:38), knowledge of the Book (13:43), and divine inscription joined to signs (7:156) sharpen the local scripture referent.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُبِينِ}} ({{tr:al-mubīni}}) closes the ayah by naming what kind of Book has just been invoked. Its case, definiteness, gender, and number lock it to {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}), so the Book is the direct bearer of the epithet, not the plural signs by themselves. The form is an active participle: the Book is manifest and makes clear, not merely clear in a passive way; that differs from abstract clarification (16:89) and from the prophet being sent to make clear (16:64), because here clarifying agency is placed on the Book itself. The root's separation field keeps clarification concrete, as meaning becomes evident by being distinguished. This final word also seals a recognizable Book-clarity formula (15:1; 26:2; 27:1; 28:2), contrasts a proof or authority bearing the same epithet (11:96), opens a same-surah clarity thread through clear error, Satan, disclosure, relational between-ness, and explanatory signs (12:5; 12:8; 12:30; 12:100; 12:111), and answers the opaque sound of {{ar:الٓر}} ({{tr:alif-lām-rā}}) with active clarification.

topics.reason: The root field supports both clarity and separation, and the local active participle lets those semantics converge as distinction-making clarity.

baseline_models.mechanism: Marked units are joined into a written composition whose work is to bring what is latent into view and expose meaning. Clarity is therefore an operation performed by the composition, not only a surface quality it possesses.

activation_trace.role: The manifest-sign branch makes each ayah a diagnostic mark within the composition.
The joining branch supplies the compositional act that binds separate signs into a book.
The ordered-letters and written-object branch gives the joined signs a textual form.
The appearing and uncovering branch makes clarity an event of manifestation.
The branch of exposing meaning by speech or sign gives the book an active explanatory function.

changed_reading.before: These are verses belonging to a book that is clear.
changed_reading.after: These are marked units of a composition that actively joins signs so that concealed meaning can appear.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct relation between آيات, الكتاب, and المبين
baseline_models.mechanism: The book joins, but البيان also separates, spaces, and connects. Its intelligibility can arise from articulated differences: units become readable because boundaries, intervals, and relations are preserved inside the whole.

activation_trace.role: The manifest-sign branch supplies distinct marked units that can differ from one another.
The joining branch supplies the whole that holds the distinct units together.
The separation branch provides boundaries by which one sign is distinguished from another.
The interval branch supplies the meaningful between-space across which signs are compared.
The connective branch prevents distinction from becoming fragmentation and makes relation itself legible.

changed_reading.before: The clear book is a uniformly transparent object.
changed_reading.after: The book becomes clear through an architecture of joined signs, maintained boundaries, intervals, and connective relations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: آيات الكتاب with المبين as disclosure
baseline_models.mechanism: The signs can be read as entries in a binding register: the book fixes a judgment or allocation, enrolls persons or positions, and eventually exposes what that registration entails.

activation_trace.role: The branch of intentionally aiming at a person's sign gives the ayat a person-indexing potential.
The branch of fixing an obligatory judgment or decree makes the book consequential rather than merely descriptive.
The enrollment branch supplies the image of names or parties entered into a register.
The uncovering branch makes the registered position and its consequence eventually visible.

changed_reading.before: The phrase announces generic scriptural verses.
changed_reading.after: The phrase may announce signs in a binding register that identifies positions, fixes consequences, and discloses them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tension between آيات and مبين
baseline_models.mechanism: A sign need not disclose at first contact. Waiting, a fixed inscription, and manifestation during an unfolding event allow المبين to name eventual or processive clarity.

activation_trace.role: The waiting and tarrying branch introduces latency into the sign.
The fixed-decree branch supplies an order already inscribed before its effects are visible.
The during-an-event branch locates disclosure inside temporal unfolding.
The uncovering branch supplies the later emergence that resolves the period of latency.

changed_reading.before: Mubin means that every sign is immediately transparent.
changed_reading.after: Mubin can name a written order whose signs become manifest during an unfolding and may require waiting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The joined book becomes a transmission-and-uptake event: it is conveyed and put into reach, gathered again in recitation, articulated, and cognitively held against ignorance. Clarity is completed across delivery, voiced assembly, and disciplined reception.

activation_trace.role: The joining branch supplies the focus model that context turns into repeated assembly.
The meaning-exposing branch supplies the active clarity whose pathway the context specifies.
The conveying branch moves the composition from source toward recipients.
The placing-in-its-station branch makes descent an ordered placement rather than bare downward motion.
The gathering branch reassembles the delivered signs as a recitable whole.
The reading and recitation branch gives the reassembled whole a voiced mode of transmission.
The articulation branch converts voiced gathering into explicit expression.
The reason-that-restrains-ignorance branch makes disciplined uptake the receiving end of disclosure.

structural_cues: 12:2 immediately sequences descent, Qur'an, Arabic qualification, and anticipated understanding after the deictic opening.
The object pronoun in أَنزَلْنَاهُ treats the introduced complex as something conveyed, while لَعَلَّكُمْ makes successful uptake prospective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conveyance, placement, gathering, articulation, and restraint from ignorance. I infer a causal path from delivery through recitation to understanding; a live alternative is that these are independent attributes rather than stages of one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The book is a completed clear object presented to sight.
changed_reading.after: The book makes clear by being placed within reach, reassembled in recitation, articulated, and held by understanding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The book's signs become an ordered recovery system. Revelation supplies hidden knowledge and an inscription image, narration follows and sequences traces, and prior heedlessness appears as material left outside alertness or without a mark. The clear book repairs that unmarked absence by arranging recoverable traces.

activation_trace.role: The manifest-sign branch supplies the marks that the context turns into a recoverable trail.
The written-composition branch supplies the durable arrangement of recovered traces.
The uncovering branch makes recovery from prior absence the mode of clarity.
The trace-following branch gives narration an evidential path rather than a loose theme.
The sequential-report branch orders the recovered path into communicable narrative.
The secretly imparted knowledge branch supplies content that is initially unavailable to ordinary awareness.
The writing and engraving branch links revelation to the focus book as inscription.
The branch of leaving something without writing or a sign supplies the precise deficit that the marked narrative repairs.

structural_cues: 12:3 places repeated ق ص ص, revelation, this Qur'an, priorness, and ghafla in one sentence.
The movement from مِن قَبْلِهِ to narrated sequence makes previous absence the temporal background of the new signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trace-following, sequential report, concealed knowledge, inscription, and an unmarked-omission branch. I infer that the book repairs lost marking by sequencing traces; a live alternative is ordinary narration overcoming inattention without an inscription-recovery mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The clear book simply states what was already available to be seen.
changed_reading.after: The clear book creates a marked, sequential trail by which what had been unrecorded or outside awareness becomes recoverable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A dream presents a compact sign-configuration, but recounting it can trigger hostile action and its meaning returns only through later outcome and taught interpretation. Mubin thus coexists with encrypted presentation, controlled circulation, and retrospective realization.

activation_trace.role: The manifest-sign branch anchors the dream configuration as a sign rather than an independent theme.
The uncovering branch supplies the eventual clarity toward which the initially compressed image moves.
The dream-vision branch gives the first sign a perceptible but not yet decoded form.
The trace-following branch makes recounting a release of the sign into a social path.
The plotting branch shows that premature circulation of a sign can alter the causal field around it.
The return-to-outcome branch activates the تأويل occurrence as retrospective realization; the paired آل index is not used for this directional arrow.
The branch of reports renewed as news makes interpretation operate across successive tellings and events.

structural_cues: 12:4 repeats رَأَيْتُ around the celestial configuration; 12:5 forbids its recounting; 12:6 promises teaching of تأويل.
The sequence makes concealment, social risk, and later interpretation successive states of one sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dream vision, trace-circulation, plotting, return to outcome, and renewed report. I infer that a clear sign may be prospectively clear yet presently compressed; a live alternative is that the dream is only one narrative episode and does not qualify المبين generally.

changed_reading.before: A sign of the clear book should disclose its meaning immediately and safely.
changed_reading.after: A sign can be visibly given yet semantically deferred, dangerous to circulate, and made clear only as events return it to its outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated ayat are now located in Yusuf and his brothers and directed to questioners. The book's signs are therefore not confined to textual segments; inquiry activates patterns embedded in persons, relations, and events.

activation_trace.role: The manifest-sign branch establishes the focus category that is repeated in the lived scene.
The exposing-by-sign branch lets contextual events perform the book's explanatory work.
The repeated manifest-sign branch relocates ayat inside Yusuf and his brothers.
The asking and seeking branch makes inquiry the recipient-side action by which embedded signs become salient.

structural_cues: 12:7 places آيات inside the construction فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِ and gives them to السائلين.
The lexical return of آيات after six verses links the focus book to a concrete relational field.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated sign word, a locative relation, and questioners. I infer that inquiry activates signs in events; a live alternative is that questioners are only an audience and the signs are already fully explicit lessons.

changed_reading.before: The ayat are textual units passively contained in the book.
changed_reading.after: The ayat also emerge as relational patterns in lived events and become especially legible under questioning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mubin crosses sharply different predications: the book, an enemy, and the brothers' accusation that their father is in error. Because the last claim comes from speakers already entering a plot, 'clear' can function as forceful framing as well as true disclosure. The book's clarity must therefore expose and adjudicate clarity-claims, not merely repeat their confidence.

activation_trace.role: The uncovering branch supplies the focus claim of manifestation against which later uses are tested.
The exposing-by-speech branch allows clarity to be examined as something asserted in language.
The plotting branch establishes a social environment in which forceful descriptions may be strategic.
The same uncovering branch names an enemy whose hostility is openly operative.
The spoken-utterance branch marks the brothers' diagnosis as a voiced claim rather than neutral narration.
The branch of saying or ascribing what is not so keeps false predication live within their speech.
The uncovering branch is recruited by the brothers to present their father's alleged error as obvious.

structural_cues: The same adjective modifies the book in 12:1, the enemy in 12:5, and the father's alleged error in the brothers' speech in 12:8.
The speaker shift from opening declaration to paternal warning to aggrieved brothers prevents lexical repetition from guaranteeing equal epistemic status.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated مبين across divergent speakers and a plotting frame. I infer that the book teaches discrimination among claims to obviousness; a live alternative is that each adjective independently intensifies its predicate without commenting on contested clarity.

changed_reading.before: Calling the book clear guarantees a simple, self-authenticating obviousness.
changed_reading.after: The clear book exposes how obviousness is predicated, including strategic or mistaken claims that only the unfolding composition can adjudicate.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the hidden depth of the well, secretly imparted knowledge contains a future report while the plotters lack fine awareness. Disclosure is planted inside concealment before any participant can read it, strongly activating the focus model of delayed manifestation.

activation_trace.role: The waiting branch supplies the interval between the hidden promise and its later readability.
The fixed-order branch lets the future disclosure be operative before it is visible.

strongest_changes: Clarity moved from a static property to a process of conveyance, recited reassembly, articulation, and disciplined uptake.
The dream and the hidden promise made المبين compatible with signs whose meaning is temporally deferred and only later returned to outcome.
Repeated مبين across divergent speakers turned clarity into a contested predication that the composition must adjudicate.
The bloodied shirt made visible evidence non-self-validating and recast the clear book as training in discrimination between disclosure and staged inscription.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots generated a productive tension between joining and separating, inscription and omission, visibility and delayed disclosure. Context did not collapse that tension: it distributed clarity across narration, inquiry, social danger, concealment, and forensic testing, while the split س ء ل inventory preserved an exploratory extraction model.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether المبين primarily describes an already clear book or an actively clarifying one remains grammatically open.
The binding-register baseline is branch-supported but less directly activated in 12:2-18 than the compositional and temporal models.
The shirt-as-counter-book analogy should remain explicitly exploratory even though the garment-that-lies branch is unusually close.
The extraction reading of السائلين depends on a non-dominant mapped root and should coexist with, not displace, ordinary asking.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Signs assembled into a disclosure.** ء ي ي B003 (visible sign), ك ت ب B001/B002 (joining; joining letters into writing), and ب ي ن B004/B005 (becoming clear; disclosing meaning) form a production sequence: discrete signs are joined, and their joining discloses. I infer that clarity emerges relationally from ordered signs. The ayah reads not simply “a clear book,” but a book whose arrangement makes latent relations visible.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:105 showed that visible signs can be repeatedly passed while still unread, and 12:111 clarified that تفصيل is what turns such signs into guidance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Disclosure against necessary concealment.** `ب ي ن:B004` is “appearance and becoming clear.” Within the clipped window, 12:4 supplies a vision and 12:5 immediately restricts its circulation, while 12:6 promises interpretation. lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak birleştirme çekirdeğini korur; dikme, bağlama, kapatma ve birlik düzenleme anlamlarını yalnızca tanıklanmış biçim ve yapılara bağlı özelleşmeler olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp aralarında fiziksel ya da topluluk oluşturan bir bağ kurmaktır. Derileri dikme, açıklıkları bağlama veya kapatma ve insan ya da atları düzenli bir birlik hâline getirme bunun yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katarak ikisini bir bütün veya bağlı bir düzen içinde birleştirmektir.
Deri parçalarını ya da bir su tulumunu dikişle birleştirmek, çekirdeğin el işi alanındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir hayvanın belirli uzuvlarını halka, kayış veya iple birbirine bağlamak ve bir kabın ağzını sıkıca kapatmak yapıya bağlı kullanımlardır.
Atların veya askerlerin toplanıp ayrı ve düzenli bir birlik oluşturması, fiziksel birleştirmeden topluluk düzenine uzanan anlamdır.
Kayışın iki yüzünü bir arada tutan boncuk, ortaya çıkan bağın somut bir örneğidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin açığa çıkması, belirginleşmesi ve açık delil olarak görünmesi çevresindedir. Geçici çerçeve bunu doğru verir; sözle açıklama dalı bundan ayrılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; kendiliğinden görünme, açıklığa kavuşturma ve belirli kanıt kalıpları ayrı facetlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin gizlilikten veya belirsizlikten çıkıp görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir; bu açıklık kanıt ya da açık işaret olarak da gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
Bir şeyi açık hale getirme ve belirsizliği giderme yönü de aynı alandadır.
Açık kanıt, açık işaret veya belirgin belge olarak adlaşmış kullanımı vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar görünme ve açıklığa kavuşma çekirdeğinde birleşir; bazı sözler açıklığı nesnede, bazıları onu açık hale getirme veya açık kanıt niteliğinde gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelme çekirdeğini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Açığa çıkma, belirginleşme ve anlaşılır olma çekirdeğini korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بان وأبان وتبين واستبان إذا ظهر الشيء واتضح، والبينة والدلالة الواضحة، والآيات البينات.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بان الشيء وأبان إذا اتضح وانكشف (maqayis)؛ البيان معروف وبان الشيء وأبان وتبين وبين واستبان (ayn)؛ بان الشيء بيانا اتضح فهو بين (sihah)؛ البينة الدلالة الواضحة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı açığa çıkarma, sözü açık olma ve anlatım yetkinliği çevresindedir. Geçici çerçeve doğru olmakla birlikte bu dalın genel görünme dalından ayrı tutulması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; anlam açıklama çekirdeği ile açık sözlü kişi kalıbı ayrı ama bağlı kullanımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir anlamı söz, yazı, işaret veya düzgün anlatımla açığa çıkarıp anlaşılır kılmadır; kişide açık ve düzgün konuşma yetisi olarak da kullanılır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, kastedilen anlamı açığa çıkarıp anlaşılır kılmadır.
Bu açıklama sadece konuşmayla değil yazı, işaret veya başka gösterme yollarıyla da olabilir.
Kişi için açık, düzgün ve etkili konuşma yetisi anlamı vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı açığa çıkarma ve sözü açık olma alanında birleşir; bazıları düzgün konuşmayı, bazıları ise konuşmadan daha geniş açıklama yollarını vurgular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Söz, yazı veya işaretle anlamı anlaşılır kılma çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Anlamı açığa çıkarma ve anlaşılır kılma çekirdeğini korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البيان بوصفه كشفا عن المعنى، والكلام أو الكتابة أو الإشارة التي تبين المقصود، والفصاحة واللسن.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أبين من فلان أي أوضح كلاما منه (maqayis)؛ البين من الرجال الفصيح (ayn)؛ البيان الفصاحة واللسن (sihah)؛ البيان الكشف عن الشيء وهو أعم من النطق (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البعد بين طرفين، والبئر البعيدة القعر أو الواسعة التي يبعد ما بين شفيرها وقعرها.
يدخل فيه البين من الأرض: القطعة أو الناحية أو الغلظ من الأرض بقدر مد البصر.

branches.branch_image_ar: انفراج العضو أو الشيء عن ملاصقه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها، والقوس البائنة التي بان وترها عن كبدها، وإبانة الرأس من الجسد.
يدخل فيه البائن في الحلب: أحد الحالبين أو الذي يأتي الحلوبة من قبل شمالها مقابل المستعلي أو المعلى.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli biçimlerin zaman bağlacı gibi kullanılarak bir olayın başka bir durum sürerken gerçekleşmesini verdiğini gösterir. Geçici çerçeve bu zaman işlevini doğru biçimde korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalın olmayan biçimdedir; tanım yalnızca bu zaman bağlacı biçimlerini kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı zaman bağlacı işleviyle açıklar; biçim, bir olayın bekleme veya başka bir sürmekte olan durum içinde gerçekleşmesini bildirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بينا وبينما إذا جعلتا بمنزلة حين وأضافتا الجملة إلى زمن الفعل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: قولك بينا فلان معناه بينما (ayn)؛ بينا نحن نرقبه أتانا أي أتانا بين أوقات رقبتنا إياه (sihah)؛ يزاد في بين ما أو الألف فيجعل بمنزلة حين (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بين بين: ما كان بين الجيد والرديء، أو الهمزة المخففة بين الهمزة وحرف اللين، أو الضعيف غير المعتد به في الشاهد.
يدخل فيه تطليقة بائنة، أي طلاق فاعلة فيه بمعنى مفعولة يدل على انقطاع الرجعة.
يدخل فيه غراب البين بوصفه الغراب الذي يتشاءم به للفراق في الخبر اللغوي.
